title: Spyglass Unleashed: Now Available for All!
summary: Get ready to experience the full power of Spyglass, which has officially transitioned from beta and is now available for all users to elevate their workflow.

summary: Explore our new public roadmap to effortlessly track recently completed features, discover what's coming next, and glimpse our exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes for Smoother Workflow
summary: We've upgraded our checkboxes to be more responsive, visually consistent, and easily draggable, transforming your task management into a seamless experience.

title: Enhanced Teamwork & Collaboration
summary: Experience effortless teamwork with enhanced collaboration features that bring greater awareness and ease to working together in real-time.

title: Enhanced Sharing & Collaboration
summary: We've made it easier than ever to discover and work together on shared items, empowering seamless collaboration among users.

summary: Explore your knowledge like never before with powerful new filtering and sharing capabilities, transforming your Constellation view into an indispensable tool for discovery and workflow.

title: Enhanced Note Layouts

summary: Get ready to experience unprecedented control and flexibility as Noeko launches with self-hosting options and tailored plans designed to fit your unique team needs.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Polished Classics
summary: Experience a vibrant upgrade to your interface with an exciting lineup of new themes and thoughtful enhancements to our current selection, designed to delight and inspire.

title: Your Day, Perfectly Greeted
